response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT ra.circuitId, c.country, ra.round FROM races ra JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = ra.circuitId), cc AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS circuit_avg FROM r GROUP BY circuitId, country), co AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS country_avg FROM r GROUP BY country) SELECT cc.circuitId, cc.country, cc.circuit_avg AS avg_round, cc.circuit_avg - co.country_avg AS diff FROM cc JOIN co ON co.country = cc.country ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The country's average round is the average over all races held in that country (race-weighted, not an average of circuit averages), counting only races whose circuit is in circuits.

Ties in the difference are left in arbitrary order; NULLs sort last, which is the default behavior of DESC in some databases but not SQLite (where NULLs sort last in DESC). No NULLs are expected anyway.

alternatives.interpretation: The country average is the unweighted mean of the per-circuit average rounds in that country, rather than the average over all races.
alternatives.sql: WITH cc AS (SELECT ra.circuitId, c.country, AVG(ra.round) AS circuit_avg FROM races ra JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = ra.circuitId GROUP BY ra.circuitId, c.country), co AS (SELECT country, AVG(circuit_avg) AS country_avg FROM cc GROUP BY country) SELECT cc.circuitId, cc.country, cc.circuit_avg AS avg_round, cc.circuit_avg - co.country_avg AS diff FROM cc JOIN co ON co.country = cc.country ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
